verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ (goods issue) delivery note WZ-261120-732 dated 20.11.2026 from Karton Nowak, Poznań to Soony DC Hamburg against order 4500318775. It covers 20.000 (20,000) PCS of CMP-GAM-004 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6, in 10 packages, gross weight 180 kg. It was stamped RECEIVED 21.11.2026 DC-HAM and signed by Yilmaz D. A handwritten remark says '1 Pal. = GH5 Sleeves!', which conflicts with the printed 'Grand Heist 6' item.
red_flags: Handwritten remark '1 Pal. = GH5 Sleeves!' suggests one pallet holds GH5 sleeves, not the ordered Grand Heist 6 (CMP-GAM-004). This is a possible product mix-up or wrong item, and the quantity of GH5 versus GH6 is not stated.
The received stamp and signature do not note any discrepancy, shortage or damage, and the remark is not tied to a quantity, so the actual GH6 quantity received may be less than 20.000.
The item description is cut off ('(USK/PE') so the full product name is not readable.
The carrier field reads 'PO 58342', which is not the order number 4500318775. It is recorded as the carrier reference.
